name: Bind
text: Roots one big enemy or boss for a few seconds.

name: Pseudopod
text: Extrudes long limbs for reach.

name: Hurl
note: Always has rubble to throw; the design needs loose objects in the room.
text: Throws loose rubble in the room at enemies.

name: Maelstrom
note: The whirlpool draws foes in and hurts them; it does not pull loose parts of yours too.
text: A whirlpool that pulls enemies in.

name: Flood
note: It slows everything in a wide patch; it does not fill the room's low ground with swimmable water.
text: Floods the low ground for a while.

name: Dissolve
note: Skips armour and opens anything in the group `dissolvable`; the world's weak gates and grates arrive with the new areas (F2). It does not corrode your own held parts.
text: Eats through a weak gate, grate or armour plate.

name: Contagion
text: Poison jumps between enemies standing close.

name: Network
note: It slows enemies on a creeping patch; it does not show the shortest route to a mark.
text: A growth spreads along the floor and slows enemies on it.

name: Guardian
note: A patrol aura that hurts what comes near; it has no visible nail that drains you when hit.
text: A patrol aura that hurts what comes near.

name: Engulf
note: It stuns the enemy where it stands and digests it; the enemy is not drawn inside the body.
text: Swallows a small enemy and holds it while it digests.

name: Ride
note: A plain glide: the fall slows for a moment; no cloud is drawn and it does not carry you sideways.
text: A short glide on a cloud.

name: Recall
note: The first cast lays a mark; the second puts you back on it in one step, not along a walked trail.
text: Lay a trail, then return along it to its start.

name: Shed
note: A husk is left and you slip away untouchable for a moment; enemies are not drawn to the husk, and it is not gone until you rest.
text: Leave a husk decoy and slip away.

name: Court
note: Three allies fight for ten seconds; they cannot be hurt, so the court does not die in one hit.
text: Spawns a few lesser slimes that fight for you.

name: Stalk
note: A stack of one-way steps appears at once; it is not a vine you hold, and it does not grow slowly.
text: Grow a climbable vine from the floor.

name: Transmute
note: Moves three of the most held first-pass element into two of the least held; there is no element chooser, it never makes fire, mind or blood, and it does not digest parts faster.
text: Convert held essence of one element into another at a loss.

name: Copy
note: Takes the last appraised creature's attack and defence for eight seconds; its shape and one of its moves wait for the creature kits (F1).
text: Take the shape and one move of the last creature you inspected, for a short time.

name: Rise
note: A stat window for standing on two legs; it does not change the body, and the claws and items it stands for wait for E.
text: Stand on two legs for claws and items, drop to four to gallop.

name: Frenzy
note: A speed and attack window; there is no bloodlust meter that builds from kills, and nothing you cannot stop.
text: Each kill stokes a bloodlust meter: faster, bleeding bites.

name: Stalk-kill
note: A heavy lunge; it is not a stealth opener and does not shrug off ranged hits.
text: A stealth opener that deals huge damage to the first target.

name: First Wolf's roar
note: Three spectral wolves fight for eight seconds; wild wolves in the room do not join.
text: Wild wolves in the room join you briefly.

name: Skin
note: A berserk window of attack and defence; there is no crash after it and no choice of when the change comes.
text: You choose the change: a berserk window with no flinch and iron-proof.

name: Shield-bite
note: A bite that ignores armour; it does not refill the berserk window on kills.
text: Breaks guards; the berserk window refills on kills.

name: Chaser
note: A speed window; marking a fleeing enemy and the free pounce are not modeled.
text: Gallop never slows; mark a fleeing enemy and the pounce is free when you catch it.

name: Slink
note: Untouchable for three seconds, standing in for unseen; enemies do not lose track of you.
text: A silent gait in dark rooms; unseen until the pounce.

name: Fear howl
note: A ring that slows what it reaches; enemies do not turn and flee.
text: Enemies falter and flee.

name: Burning pounce
note: A fire lunge; it leaves no flame trail and it does not hurt a packmate.
text: A burning pounce and a flame trail.

name: Omen
note: Marks the nearest enemy; it takes the blow after ten seconds whether or not it cleanses.
text: Mark one enemy; it dies in ten seconds unless it cleanses.

name: Spectral pack
note: Two echoes fight for eight seconds; they do not pounce when you do.
text: Two echoes of you pounce with you.

name: Hunt's passage
note: A long glide that needs no kill first; no pack carries you.
text: The pack carries you over one gap (a short glide).

name: Three barks
note: One unavoidable bolt; there are no two warning barks first.
text: Two warnings, then a lunge you cannot dodge from range.

name: Bond
note: A packmate for twenty seconds; it is not a lasting bond and the pounce is not heavier.
text: A heavier pounce, knockback, one bonded packmate.

name: Tank
note: A shove that stuns for a moment; heavy targets are not knocked down and the body is not knockback-proof.
text: The pounce knocks down heavy targets; knockback-proof.

name: Unbound
note: Breaks armour and anything in the group dissolvable; the world's barriers and grates arrive with the new areas (F2).
text: Breaks barriers and grates (a gate-breaking verb).

name: Lone hunter
note: An attack window; it does not look for isolated prey and does not switch the bond off.
text: Strongest with no packmate, hunts isolated prey.

name: Guardian
note: A patch that mends you while you stand in it; it wards no packmate and holds no holy ground.
text: Wards a packmate, holds holy ground, unharmed in holy zones.

name: Opener
note: Shows nodes in the group hidden; the world's hidden exits and shortcuts arrive with the new areas (F2).
text: Reveals hidden exits and shortcuts in a room.

name: Suckle
note: A healing patch; no pup grows into a second packmate.
text: Heals packmates and grows a pup into a second packmate.

name: Devour
note: Heals you; it needs no corpse to eat, and the slow heavy swing is not modeled.
text: Devour corpses to heal; slow, heavy swings.

name: Rend
note: A claw that stuns for a moment; the paralysing touch and the stench cloud are one strike here.
text: Claws, a paralysing touch, a stench cloud.

name: Drain
note: A bite that heals you by part of what it deals; blood essence and items are not modeled.
text: Uses items; devours blood.

name: Hop
note: A bounding lunge that drains on touch; it can turn mid-way and talisman rooms do not stop it.
text: Bounding straight-line leaps that drain on touch.

name: Heft
note: A huge swing; it does not swell as it kills.
text: Huge barrow-blade swings; it swells as it kills.

name: Barrow slam
note: A ground-pound ring that stuns; the armour from carried items is not modeled.
text: A ground-pound shockwave; armour while carrying items.

name: Cleaver
note: A cleaving swing; the extra graft slots are not modeled.
text: Heft cleaver; extra graft slots (a stitched body).

name: Overhead cleave
note: A slow heavy swing; the shield is not modeled.
text: A slow overhead cleave and a shield.

name: Vengeance
note: A heavy swing; it does not hit harder against what killed your last life.
text: Hits harder against the creature that killed your last life; heavy swings.

name: Herald
note: A long reach standing in for the whip; the thrown head is the same strike.
text: A long whip, a thrown head.

name: Juggernaut
note: A stomp ring that stuns; walking through hazards and the double size are not modeled.
text: Double size, stomp and heft cleave; walks through hazards.

name: Sow
note: Two bone soldiers fight for ten seconds; block and spear thrust are not modeled and you are not rooted.
text: Shield wall: block and spear thrust; sow two bone soldiers.

name: Squad
note: Four bone soldiers fight for ten seconds.
text: A squad of four sown soldiers.

name: Rise
note: Three dancers fight for ten seconds; they do not rise from downed enemies.
text: Downed enemies stand up as dancers for ten seconds.

name: Bone throw
note: The bone does not return to your hand.
text: Returning bone throws, bow arm.

name: Sure shot
note: A sure shot; the six-then-a-cursed-seventh count is not modeled.
text: Six sure shots, then a cursed seventh.

name: Life-arrow
note: A piercing arrow across the room; it costs no HP.
text: Spend most of your HP on one arrow that crosses the room and pierces.

name: Mark
note: Marks the nearest enemy; the blow follows after three seconds, not as homing arrows.
text: Arrows home on one marked prey.

name: Lure-light
note: A lingering light that slows what enters; enemies do not follow it into hazards.
text: Enemies follow a drifting light into hazards.

name: Trick
note: Holds one enemy for three seconds; no lure must be placed first.
text: An enemy that touches your lure is held fast.

name: Wail
text: A cone that stuns and frightens.

name: Minions
note: Two bone minions fight for ten seconds; the focus is not modeled.
text: A few bone minions; a focus.

name: Bone beams
note: A beam that jumps between enemies; there is no blink and no phylactery.
text: Bouncing bone beams, a blink; a phylactery anchors remains.

name: Hidden soul
note: Lays a mark and returns you to it; it does not raise you when you die in range.
text: Place an anchor; if you die in range you rise there once per life.

name: Float
note: A slow fall; the body does not really float.
text: A floating skull, very frail, very strong.

name: Consecrate
note: A ring of light that heals you and burns enemies; it does not heal your summons.
text: A ring of light that heals you and your summons and burns the living.

name: Wrap
text: Bandages bind enemies; a sand gust.

name: Decree
note: A curse that follows you and hurts what comes near; no tomb guards rise.
text: A curse ring marks everything in the room; tomb guards rise.

name: Weigh
note: A drain that works on every foe, not only the weaker; the weighing is not modeled.
text: If a creature's essence is lower than yours, drain it at once.
